501.rationale: EV-FARE-00501 is UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 24.50 and total_charged 39.00, so POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run. The two ECP gantries (3.00 + 3.00) sit on the driven route but EV-TRIP-00501.optimal_route_erp_sgd is 0.00: they are off the optimal corridor and were incurred only because of the unauthorised routing, so they are not 'properly chargeable' pass-throughs under POL-RD-11(a)/POL-RD-09. Refund under POL-RD-11(a)+(b) = charged_total 39.00 minus quoted 24.50 minus properly chargeable pass-throughs 0.00 = 14.500, rounded up to 14.50; that figure contains the 6.00 of off-route ERP as the POL-RD-11(b) correction and it is itemised, not added twice. EV-GPS-00501 trace 25.40 km vs optimal 19.6 km (29.6%) confirms the deviation but is not needed for the money. PARTIAL_REFUND 14.50.

Limb (c) adds a driver-conduct referral. The rider's other trips and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter are not evidence for this trip (POL-GEN-01). FULL_REFUND 17.92.

516.rationale: EV-TRIP-00516 shows dropoff_amended_at 4 minutes into the trip with amended_optimal_distance_km 11.6, so POL-RD-05 is available and the amended route is the baseline; the chat pressure that preceded the rider's 'ok fine' is not a ground the policy prices. 520.rationale: Driver-filed. EV-CHAT-00520 MSG-00520-001 is a rider message 30 s after departure naming Sheng Siong Blk 501 with a populated waypoint_hint; EV-GPS-00520 passes within 200 m of that coordinate and dwells there four minutes, so POL-RD-04(a)-(c) are met and the trace corroborates. Compensation = 0.75 x 2.53 = 1.897, rounded UP to 1.90, within the 15.00 cap. Per POL-GEN-03 the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION 1.90 with amount_sgd mirroring it; the rider's own charge stands.

Under POL-RD-11(b) the same correction applies on an upfront trip. Refund = 12.00 - 10.00 - 0.00 properly chargeable = 2.00 -> 2.00. The contested amount on DSP-00521 is exactly this line, so under POL-GEN-03 the filing party is entirely right on the whole contested sum: FULL_REFUND 2.00; referral billing integrity.

EV-GPS-00522 passes within 250 m of that gantry's coordinates and EV-TRIP-00522.optimal_route_erp_sgd is 5.00: the gantry lies on the optimal route and was actually crossed, so under POL-RD-09 it is a legitimate pass-through, not a phantom line. Under POL-GEN-03 the present state stands. NO_ACTION.

The airport_surcharge 6.00 is proper on a trip ORIGINATING at Changi. There is no clause under which this gantry is refundable, and the cash the rider handed over is not in the pool. NO_ACTION; the ruling should say the policy leaves a sub-threshold route choice with the driver.

EV-GPS-00601 does contain a qualifying arrival (first in-radius fix at 21:46:50, LARGE_VENUE radius 120 m), but the vehicle leaves the geofence after 65 s and is more than 1 km away at cancellation: the continuous in-geofence dwell is 65 s against the 300 s minimum, so POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation. POL-NS-04 also holds: the rider's message at 21:47 on EV-CHAT-00601 is a locating message, EV-TRIP-00601.in_app_calls is empty and no reply followed, and rider_track keeps the rider within the 150 m presence radius (mean 16 m). FULL_REFUND 4.00.
